reuse.why: Introduces a shared selection and predicate used by four actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own condition instead of calling shouldSetMonthBudget even though its rows carry the same fields.

duplication.why: The saved-template SQL CASE expression is written twice (getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories), and the hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion is expressed both in shouldSetMonthBudget and inline in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection and predicate sit in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them, which is where the tree keeps this logic.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their category query and one test change.

maintainability.why: Consolidating four of the actions is an improvement, but a change to the exclusion rule still has to be made in two SQL expressions and two TypeScript conditions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts tests hidden/group_hidden/has_saved_templates itself instead of using the new shouldSetMonthBudget predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The exclusion rule appears as shouldSetMonthBudget (=== 0 conjunction) and as copyPreviousMonth's (=== 1 disjunction) early return, the same rule reshaped; the has_saved_templates CASE is repeated across two queries.

one_place.where: The rule is split between shouldSetMonthBudget/getMonthActionCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and copyPreviousMonth's inline check fed by getBudgetData's separate CASE expression.
